properties.description: Pins the relation through the served tools: external_dependency keeps a stored relation and interfaces on a re-declare that leaves them out, upstream_status reads them back under members, and loop_status names a member linked by nothing under members_unlinked even when nothing is watched (a hosted design cannot watch another), going quiet once the relation is stated.
properties.name: a_hub_member_states_its_relation_through_the_tools.rs
